primary_question: Can a modality-aware routed triage system provide reproducible sensitivity-constrained operating points across head CT, chest X-ray, and knee MRI?
selection_policy: Model and threshold choices use training, validation, and calibration partitions only.
locked_test_policy: Locked test predictions cannot be used for tuning, preprocessing selection, threshold selection, or model selection.
uncertainty: Confidence intervals use patient- or exam-grouped bootstrap sampling when identifiers are available.
reporting: Every reported result must identify its cohort, evaluation unit, sample size, checkpoint hash, split hash, seed, and Git commit.

phase_2_selective_prediction.selection_rule: smallest margin meeting prespecified minimum coverage and maximum automatic false-negative rate
phase_2_selective_prediction.uncertainty: patient- or exam-grouped percentile bootstrap confidence intervals
phase_2_selective_prediction.locked_test_policy: margin and constraints must be locked before evaluation; prior test cohorts may only be reported as post-test exploratory analyses
